ideas.pitch: A real-time campus resource and crowd-density monitoring platform built for Maharaja Agrasen College to manage lab equipment, seminar halls, and common facilities.
ideas.title: MACSTAK Campus Flow and Resource Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets the host institution directly, making the impact immediately clear and relatable to the organizing jury from the Department of Computer Science.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent sustainability assistant designed to audit energy consumption, waste management, and resource allocation across university departments.
ideas.title: Campus GreenNovation Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages proven multi-agent design patterns from recent winning projects to demonstrate production-ready prototype engineering.

ideas.pitch: A localized multilingual health guidance and preventive care chatbot tailored for college dispensary triage and rural health outreach initiatives.
ideas.title: UniDoc Health Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses social impact with clear, measurable utility for local student and community populations.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video transcription and concept-search platform that transforms unstructured lecture recordings into searchable academic databases.
ideas.title: LectureLens Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an everyday pain point for university students with an impressive multimedia processing pipeline built for a tight live demonstration.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven nutrition tracker that scans campus canteen menus to provide personalized dietary recommendations and macro breakdowns for students.
ideas.title: Campus Canteen Nutrition AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features an instantly demonstrable UI and solves a consumer-facing wellness problem that resonates well with a collegiate jury.
